title: Lombard Street: A Description of the Money Market
scope: I independently read every source line of all 13 original chapters, all 13 complete Chinese dossiers, every retrieved Appendix A-D paragraph and table, the full synthesis, expert explanation and all 26 rules. I also read the 49 frontmatter lines. I did not reread all PG license paragraphs, physical scan glyphs, external bank accounts, or all outside historical records. Printed base edition remains unconfirmed.
